$comment: Stock valuation (lib/valuation.js): the methods a store chooses between (settings commerce.stockValuation) and the accounts each movement of valued stock posts to. fifo: a unit that leaves takes the cost of the oldest units on hand. average: every unit on hand of an item carries the same cost — the layers are evened out before each issue — so a unit that leaves takes the weighted average.

labels.opening: Stock on hand given its opening cost
